notes.title: Update: Gnome Booster
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/J4AJixP.jpg[/img]
-Added a gnome themed booster pack, containing 18 cards.
-Added 3 cards in the base deck, also re-balanced some of the minions.

The idea behind the gnomes is that they all boost each other, useless on their own but dangerous together.

Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Content Update: "The Joker"
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]40 new cards.
    [*]Hero level up, as pick-option.
    [*]Added random modifiers that varies the gameplay.
    [*]Remade most of the textures, and cards has better resolution.
    [*]Remade the card explaining GUI.
    [*]Rebalanced a lot of cards, a few of them has got new powers.
    [*]Font is extended to cover Russian, Chinese, Japanese and Thai names.
    [*]Removed fullscreen, game runs smoother as borderless window, and works better across multiple screens.
[/list] 
I would love to hear what you think of the changes to Hearthclone.. I mean Di.. em.. Pick a Hero. My favorite is the Evil Lab Bunny, you can really go nuts with that card ːbunnieloveː

notes.title: Launch notes and network patches
notes.content:
All reported crashes has been fixed in the latest update. I have been tweaking the network many times since launch. The biggest issue has been the dead lobbies that Steam leaves going for some reason.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/58TsYX5.jpg[/img]

Board games are rarely a hit on Steam, and my game has been pretty must a disaster in terms of popularity. But I have a few fans here and there that keeps me going. I will keep updating even if sales are low, mostly for the sake of good-will.
